## Business Overview

**Business name:** On Demand Detailing

**Founded:** 2020
**Website:** https://www.detailod.com
**Phone:** (661) 862-2372
**Email:** ondemanddetailinginc@gmail.com
**Service area:** Bakersfield, CA (mobile only — detailer comes to the customer's location)

## Services and Pricing

All services are mobile — Brian comes to the customer's location in Bakersfield, CA.

| Service                       | Starting Price |
|-------------------------------|---------------|
| Interior & Exterior Detail    | $249           |
| Interior Only Detail          | $199           |
| Engine Bay Detail             | $100           |
| Odor Eliminating Treatment    | $50 (add-on)   |
| Paint Enhancement             | $299           |
| Ceramic Coating               | $350           |
| Headlight Restoration         | $80            |

### Interior & Exterior Detail — Starting at $249
- Deep clean of tires, wheels, and inner barrels
- Bug removal and pre-soak to prevent swirl marks
- Hand foam wash and dry
- Spray wax with UV protection
- Non-greasy matte tire dressing
- Thorough interior vacuum
- Hot steam sanitation
- Full shampoo and heated water extraction
- Odor eliminator bomb for strong odor removal
- Leather and vinyl seat conditioning
- UV-protected dark plastic trim conditioning
- Air freshener

### Interior Only Detail — Starting at $199
- Thorough vacuum throughout the full interior
- Hot steam sanitation for maximum cleaning results
- Full shampoo and heated water extraction
- Odor eliminator bomb for strong odor removal
- Leather and vinyl seat conditioning
- UV-protected dark plastic trim conditioning
- Air freshener

### Engine Bay Detail — Starting at $100
- Sensitive components safely covered for protection
- Degreasing and agitation with dedicated detail brushes
- Careful rinse and full blow-dry for safe startup
- Non-oily dressing on plastics and trim
- Exterior wash included
- Wheels, inner barrels, and tires cleaned and shined

### Odor Eliminating Treatment — $50 add-on
- Chemical odor bomb treatment after interior detailing
- One-hour circulation to neutralize stubborn odors
- Process reaches vents, fabrics, and interior surfaces
- Vehicle aired out with A/C cycling after treatment
- Note: Cabin air filter replacement recommended for best long-term results

### Paint Enhancement — Starting at $299
- Thorough exterior wash and paint decontamination
- Clay treatment to remove bonded surface contaminants
- Iron removal from paint and glass
- One-step machine polish to enhance gloss and clarity
- Complimentary paint sealant included
- Up to 3 months UV protection and hydrophobic properties

### Ceramic Coating — Starting at $350
- Durable long-term protection
- Repels water, dirt, and grime
- Protects against harsh UV rays
- Enhances paint gloss and slickness
- Options from 1–5 year protection
- Note: Deposit required; drop-off may be required for paint correction

### Headlight Restoration — Starting at $80
- Removes oxidation and haze from headlights
- Improves clarity and function
- Includes 1-year protective coating
- Cost-effective service that improves vehicle appearance and value

---

## Vehicle Types Serviced

Cars, trucks, SUVs, RVs, boats, motorcycles, and fleet vehicles.

---

## Key Differentiators

- **Mobile service:** Brian comes to the customer — no need to drop off or wait at a shop.
- **Solo operator:** Brian personally handles every job, providing full attention on each vehicle.
- **Satisfaction guarantee:** Brian does a walkthrough before leaving and fixes any touch-ups on the spot.
- **5+ years of experience:** Started in 2020, has detailed luxury vehicles (Porsche, Mercedes, BMW, Lexus, Tesla, Corvette), classics, big rigs, RVs, boats, and motorcycles.
- **Professional equipment:** Operates from a fully equipped van with professional-grade tools and products.
- **Weekly and monthly plans available:** Discounts on 3 or more vehicles; monthly membership option for ongoing care.

---

## Payment Methods

Cash, Zelle, Apple Pay, debit card, credit card.
No deposit required except for paint correction and ceramic coatings (non-refundable deposit).

---

## Scheduling

- Book 2–3 days in advance recommended.
- Same-day or emergency service sometimes available — call to check.
- Phone: (661) 862-2372

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Do you offer paint correction?**
Yes. For paint correction, drop-off may be required.

**What types of vehicles do you service?**
Cars, trucks, SUVs, RVs, boats, motorcycles, and fleets.

**Do you come to my location?**
Yes — mobile only. Brian comes to you anywhere in Bakersfield, CA.

**Which areas do you serve?**
Bakersfield, CA only.

**How far in advance should I schedule?**
Book 2–3 days in advance when possible.

**Do you offer same-day or emergency service?**
Sometimes — call (661) 862-2372 to check availability.

**Do you require a deposit?**
No deposit except for paint correction and ceramic coatings (non-refundable).

**What payment methods do you accept?**
Cash, Zelle, Apple Pay, debit, and credit.

**How long does a detail take?**
Typically 2–4 hours for a complete detail.

**Do you guarantee your work?**
Yes — Brian does a walkthrough before leaving and will fix touch-ups on the spot.

## Developer Notes

- This file lives at `frontend/public/llms.txt` and is served statically at `/llms.txt`.
- Markdown mirror files live at `frontend/public/*.md` and are served at their respective paths.
- To add a new page: (1) create `frontend/public/pagename.md`, (2) add it to the "Important Pages" section of this file, (3) add it to `sitemap.xml`.
- Content is sourced from React component data in `frontend/src/pages/` and `frontend/src/components/`.
- When updating business info (hours, prices, services), update this file and the relevant `.md` mirrors to match.
